name.description: Unique name for this etcd node in the cluster (alphanumeric, no spaces).

initial_cluster.description: List of initial cluster members in the format 'name=http://host:port'. Used at cluster bootstrap.

initial_cluster_state.description: Initial cluster state: 'new' for new cluster, 'existing' for adding nodes to an existing cluster.

initial_cluster_token.description: Cluster token for cluster discovery. All members must use the same token.

advertise_client_urls.description: List of client URLs exposed for client connections (e.g., public IPs or DNS).

initial_advertise_peer_urls.description: List of peer URLs advertised to other cluster members.

listen_client_urls.description: List of URLs the server listens on for client requests.

listen_peer_urls.description: List of URLs the server listens on for peer (cluster) traffic.

data_dir.description: Path to the directory where etcd stores its data (must be writable).

snapshot_count.description: Number of transactions between snapshots (lower = more frequent snapshots, higher = more writes before snapshot).

election_timeout.description: Election timeout in milliseconds — time allowed before starting a new election.

heartbeat_interval.description: Heartbeat interval in milliseconds — how often peers send heartbeats.

max_requests_per_second.description: Rate limit for client requests (0 = unlimited). Helps prevent overload during traffic spikes.

enable_v2.description: Enable legacy v2 API (not recommended — only if needed for older clients).

enable_trace.description: Enable verbose request tracing (useful for debugging, increases log size).

enable_pprof.description: Enable /debug/pprof endpoints for runtime profiling (security-sensitive — disable in production).

metrics.description: Level of metrics exposed on /metrics endpoint: 'basic', 'extensive' (more detailed), or 'none' (disabled).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. 'debug' for detailed logs; 'info' for standard production logs.

log_format.description: Log format: 'text' for human-readable, 'json' for structured logging (e.g., for log aggregators).

client_cert_auth.description: Require TLS client certificates for client connections.

trusted_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying client certificates (if client_cert_auth is true).

cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate for client connections.

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key for client connections.

peer_client_cert_auth.description: Require TLS client certificates from other cluster members.

peer_trusted_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying peer node certificates.

peer_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate for peer-to-peer communication.

peer_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key for peer-to-peer communication.

auto_compaction_retention.description: Auto-compaction retention period (e.g., '1h' = hourly compaction, '1000000' = per-revision mode).

auto_compaction_mode.description: Compaction mode: 'periodic' (time-based) or 'revision' (based on revision count).

quota_backend_bytes.description: Maximum backend storage size in bytes (e.g., 8 GiB = 8589934592). Prevents unbounded growth.

snapshot_count_max.description: Maximum number of snapshot files to retain on disk.

debug.description: Enable low-level debugging (disables log rotation, may degrade performance — not for production).
